description: Shared SSG/FM balance for all tracks and SSG channels; no changes to source volume, envelopes, pitch or timing.

calibration.method: Dominant-band recording comparison relative to FM, using analysis-only native stems to select bands. Shared native SSG gain 45/64 (-3.059 dB).
calibration.scope: Calibrated to the supplied reference excerpt; soundtrack and SFX subsequently user-approved for M4. Not a universal claim about every PC-98 board or emulator.
